description: A composite risk index combining tropical cyclone regime shifts and sea level rise to evaluate mangrove vulnerability globally

sea_level_rise_risk.basis: IPCC AR6 SSP scenarios (2080-2100 average rates)
sea_level_rise_risk.reference: Saintilan et al. (2023): deficit likely at 4 mm/yr, highly likely at 7 mm/yr

tropical_cyclone_risk.basis: Historical TC frequency and intensity from MIT model (1850-2014)
tropical_cyclone_risk.reference: Mo et al. (2023); Kropf et al. (2023)
